SELECT 'store' k, CAST(store_key AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) b, store_name c, city d, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) e, CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) f FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Palokka%' OR city ILIKE '%Jyv%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'prod', CAST(product_key AS VARCHAR), CAST(sku AS VARCHAR), product_name, category, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR), CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_product WHERE sku = 100011
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cal', fiscal_year, CAST(fiscal_week AS VARCHAR), CAST(fiscal_week_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(fiscal_week_end_date AS VARCHAR), '', '' FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date = DATE '2026-10-08'

calls.statement:
SELECT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units, f.closing_value, f.receipts_units, f.adjustment_units, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND f.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30'
ORDER BY f.week_ending_date, f.etl_loaded_at
SELECT max(calendar_date) max_date, max(week_ending_date) FROM dim_date, (SELECT max(week_ending_date) week_ending_date FROM fact_stock_week)

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS week_ending, sum(f.quantity) units_sold, count(*) lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-09-07'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
